title: The generic residue-field arrow of the eliminated polynomial projection
statement: Let A be a finite type domain over a field k and g₁,…,gₙ∈A. Define p:Spec A[x₁,…,xₙ]→Spec k[t₀,…,tₙ] by t₀↦−Σgᵢxᵢ and tᵢ↦xᵢ. If p is dominant, its generic residue-field arrow is isomorphic to Spec Ω→Spec F, where Ω=Frac(Frac(A)[x₁,…,xₙ]) and F=k(x₁,…,xₙ,Σgᵢxᵢ) is the intermediate field defined in lem-zl-bertini-field-extension.

source.place: Tag 0G4F, proof; tensor-pullback and affine-coordinate details

proof.text: Identify affine generic residue fields with fraction fields using the canonical maps from the coordinate rings and generic stalk localizations. Dominance makes the polynomial substitution injective. Localize this substitution and identify its image with the field generated by the variables and the linear combination; negating that combination does not change this field. Fraction-field uniqueness supplies the two compatible field isomorphisms, and Spec gives the arrow isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem bertiniPolynomialResidueArrow
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (A : CommRingCat.{u})
    [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A] [IsDomain A]
    (n : ℕ) (g : Fin n → A)
    (hp : IsDominant (bertiniEliminatedProjection k A n g)) :
    let p := bertiniEliminatedProjection k A n g
    Nonempty (Arrow.mk
      (Spec.map (p.residueFieldMap (genericPoint (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)))))) ≅
      Arrow.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap
        (FieldTheory.bertiniBaseField k (FractionRing A) n
          (fun i ↦ algebraMap A (FractionRing A) (g i)))
        (FieldTheory.bertiniOmega (FractionRing A) n)))))
